_comment: Which EU ETS installations belong to which peer. scripts/collect_ets.py matches the installation name (and the account holder, if the file has it) against 'patterns' (case-insensitive regular expressions). Check the matches in the pop-up on the Peers page after the first run: add wrong ones to 'exclude' and missing ones to 'include' as "<country code>-<installation id>", e.g. "DE-1234". Only sites in the EU, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein are covered (not the UK or Switzerland). 'fromYear' and 'excludeRegistries' keep the time series comparable: UK sites left the EU ETS at the end of 2020 (GB), so they are left out.

source.attribution: European Commission, Union Registry – verified emissions (CC BY 4.0)

_notGlobal: The global peers (Kimberly-Clark, P&G, Georgia-Pacific, APP, Hengan, CMPC Softys, Kruger) have no or almost no tissue mills in the EU, so their EU ETS numbers would not be representative. Add them here only if that changes.
